$description: N S Lootah Group design tokens, from the 2026 Company Profile. Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 (https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format/). Token paths map to CSS custom properties by joining with '-': color.gold becomes --color-gold. Fluid sizes (clamp) live in global.css, built on the font-size maxima here.

palette.$description: Base tokens: the profile's cool off-white page, black ink and hairlines, and the amber gold of the Group monogram. Use the semantic colour tokens in designs, not these.

bg.$description: Page background, the profile's cool off-white.

paper.$description: White, for cards and form fields that sit on the page.

rule.$description: 1px hairline between items in a list or group.

muted.$description: Ledes, labels and captions. 5.3:1 on bg, 4.8:1 on surface.

ink.$description: Headings, body copy and the strong rule that opens a section.

primary.$description: The one solid button and the skip link.

on-dark-muted.$description: Secondary text on black. 8.6:1 on black.

gold.$description: The accent word that ends a heading, numbers and hairline buttons. Display sizes only on light grounds (3.9:1 on bg); any size on black.

gold-ink.$description: Gold for small text, labels and hovers on light grounds. 5.6:1 on bg.

gold-glow.$description: Gold for small text and hovers on black. 9.3:1 on black.

glass.$description: The frosted header: the page colour, nearly opaque, over a blur.

wash.$description: The page-coloured wash that turns hero photographs into a pale print.

serif.$description: Lora (variable, with italic), the English display face: headings, the hero and the gold italic accent. SIL Open Font License.

sans.$description: DM Sans (Regular, Medium), the English text face: body, labels, navigation and buttons. SIL Open Font License.

arabic.$description: IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Regular, Medium, Bold), Arabic running text and UI; legible at 16 to 18px. Its Latin covers digits and English words. SIL Open Font License.

arabic-display.$description: Almarai (Regular, Bold), Arabic headings and display. Never used for running text. SIL Open Font License.

medium.$description: Labels, navigation and buttons in English.

bold.$description: Arabic headings (Almarai Bold) and Arabic labels.

font-size.$description: The largest size of each step. Headings scale down fluidly from these (see the --text-* roles in global.css).

label.$description: Capitalised, tracked labels (eyebrows). Arabic labels use small, uncapitalised.

out.$description: Strong ease-out. Anything entering, and press feedback.

in-out.$description: Strong ease-in-out. Things moving while already on screen, such as photo reveals.

standard.$description: The CSS 'ease' curve, for colour changes.

colour.$description: Hover and focus colour changes (the house 0.3s ease).

small.$description: Arrow nudges and other small hover movement.

enter.$description: Section entrances on scroll, played once.

reveal.$description: Photograph reveals on scroll, played once.

stagger.$description: Gap between items entering as a group.

enter.$description: Section content: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY 1rem to 0, once, staggered.

reveal.$description: Photographs: a cover of the photo's average colour wipes away once it has loaded.

hairline.$description: Divides items within a list or group.

arabic-body.$description: Arabic running text needs more line height than Latin.
